metadata.name: noised_hook
metadata.description: Launch Guard: a bounded, stateless Token-2022 transfer hook for Meteora DBC launches

instructions.name: create_policy
docs: Write the launch policy for a mint. Only the launchpad can sign. The
creator's rules, if any, must verify for this guard (`InvalidRules`).

accounts.name: launchpad_authority
docs: The launchpad's PDA; only the launchpad program can produce this signature.

instructions.name: end_snipe_shield
docs: End the snipe shield now. Only the launchpad can sign, and it does so
only in `execute_batch`, after the batch bought for the launch's own
policy: from then on the shield has nothing left to protect, so public
trading opens at once instead of at the end of the execution window.
The only effect is `snipe_shield_end_ts = min(snipe_shield_end_ts,
now)` (`rules::shield_end_after_batch`): the end never moves later,
and every other field, the guard rules and their end included, stays
as written. Defense in depth: the top-level instruction must be the
launchpad's `execute_batch` (`NotInBatch`). The mint is not read and
its hook need not be active: when the batch completes the curve, DBC
revokes the hook inside that same swap, and `execute_batch` must
still succeed.

accounts.name: launchpad_authority
docs: The launchpad's PDA; only the launchpad program can produce this
signature (it does so only in `execute_batch`, after the batch buy).

accounts.name: policy
docs: A Launch Guard policy PDA (`["policy", mint]`); the launchpad passes
its own launch's. Only `snipe_shield_end_ts` changes.

accounts.name: instructions
docs: top-level instruction must be the launchpad's `execute_batch`.

instructions.name: execute
docs: Token-2022 `Execute`: decide one transfer, as `rules::evaluate`
does. Sells and everything after the guard are decided from the
policy's head (`PolicyHead`) before the policy is decoded. Then the
built-in checks (`rules::built_ins`) read the source's owner, and the
destination's owner, balance and extensions (`has_immutable_owner`),
from their own account data; only a transfer they leave to the
creator rules, under a policy that has some, also reads the mint's
supply and the transaction's top-level instructions (`top_level`).

accounts.name: instructions
docs: when it is read (buys during the snipe shield, and transfers that
reach creator rules).

instructions.name: initialize_extra_account_meta_list
docs: Create the mint's ExtraAccountMetaList. Permissionless and
deterministic: the list always holds exactly the policy PDA and the
instructions sysvar.

errors.name: SnipeShield
errors.msg: Launch guard: buying opens when the snipe-shield countdown ends

errors.name: TransfersLocked
errors.msg: Launch guard: wallet-to-wallet transfers are paused until the guard ends

errors.name: MaxBuy
errors.msg: Launch guard: transfer is larger than the max-buy cap

errors.name: MaxWallet
errors.msg: Launch guard: receiving account would exceed the max-wallet cap

errors.name: WrongHookProgram
errors.msg: Mint's transfer hook is not this program

errors.name: PolicyMismatch
errors.msg: Policy belongs to a different mint

errors.name: InvalidPolicy
errors.msg: Policy is outside the hook's hard bounds

errors.name: InvalidPool
errors.msg: Pool is not a Meteora DBC account

errors.name: NotInBatch
errors.msg: Only the launchpad's execute_batch can end the snipe shield

errors.name: MutableOwner
errors.msg: Launch guard: the receiving token account must have an immutable owner while the guard is on

errors.name: RuleDenied
errors.msg: Launch rule: this transfer is not allowed right now

errors.name: InvalidRules
errors.msg: Launch rules do not verify (PXR1) for this guard

types.name: HookPolicy
docs: Per-mint launch policy. Written once by the launchpad; no instruction can
close it, and the only change any instruction can make is
`end_snipe_shield` moving `snipe_shield_end_ts` earlier once the batch has
bought. It stops mattering when DBC revokes the hook at curve completion.
Its space is exactly its content (`HookPolicy::space`).

fields.name: pool
docs: Meteora DBC pool of this launch.

fields.name: base_vault
docs: DBC base vault: transfers into it (sells) are always allowed and
transfers out of it are buys.

fields.name: snipe_shield_end_ts
docs: Until this time nobody can buy from the pool except the batch. Written
as the end of the launchpad's execution window; when the batch
executes earlier, `end_snipe_shield` sets it to that moment.

fields.name: guard_end_ts
docs: From this time on every transfer is allowed.

fields.name: max_wallet
docs: Max balance of a receiving account during the guard (0 = off).

fields.name: max_buy
docs: Max tokens received per transfer during the guard (0 = off).

fields.name: p2p_locked
docs: Pause wallet-to-wallet transfers during the guard.

fields.name: exempt
docs: Owners whose transfers skip the rules (launchpad PDAs). Unused slots
are `Pubkey::default()`, which never matches.

fields.name: rules
docs: The creator's launch rules (PXR1, `noised_rules::rules`), verified
by `create_policy` against `guard_secs`; empty for none. They can
only refuse, and are checked after every built-in allow and denial
(`rules::evaluate`).

fields.name: rules_len
docs: Bytes of the creator's rules (0: none).

fields.name: rules
docs: PXR1 bytes (empty for none), stored as given once they verify.

types.name: SnipeShieldEnded
docs: `execute_batch` ended the snipe shield (`end_snipe_shield`).

fields.name: scheduled_end_ts
docs: The end the policy held before the call: from `execute_batch`, the
scheduled end written by `create_policy` (the end of the launchpad's
execution window), which the launch certificate keeps.

fields.name: snipe_shield_end_ts
docs: The end from now on: `min(scheduled_end_ts, now)`. Buys pass from
then on, under the guard rules until the unchanged `guard_end_ts`.
